SHANGHAI, January 5, 1944
416 TONGSHAN ROAD, HOUSE 22
TEL. 50192

S. Yamaguchi, Esq.
c/o Police Headquarters,
Shanghai Special Municipality,
First District Administration,
185 Foochow Road,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

On the occasion of the New Year, the Juedische Gemeinde
takes the liberty of wishing you the very best and hopes
that the little assistance, we could give the Authorities
concerned with our cooperation might be useful, and we
shall, of course, be at your disposal with such cooperation
also for the future.

In honour of the Authorities, we are going to arrange for a
NEW YEAR'S DINNER
on
Monday, January 10, 1944 at 6.30 p.m.
at the
"WHITE HORSE", 178 Ward Road,

and we do hope that at this occasion you will honour us by
your presence.

We are, Sir,

Your obedient Servants,
JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE

Commissioner

SUBJECT: Inauguration Ceremony for the "Tuition Con-
tinuation" Courses of the Jewish Gemeinde

At 11 a.m. on Sept.12th,1943 at the Broadway
Cinema, 57 Wayside Rd, a ceremony was held for the above
purpose, which was attended by about 500 persons. The
ceremony consisted of speeches, and choir and solo vo-
cal renditions.

Mr.Glaser, executive of the Jewish Gemeinde
opened the ceremony by a speech in English in which he
explained that the present administration had soon re-
alized the importance of youth education and that all
efforts must be made to further this purpose. He also
referred to the Economic Section as the basis of all
productive work, and future collaboration between the
institution of the courses and the Economic Section with
a view to finding work for unemployed youth. Of interest
at the
was also his remark that coming renewal of special passes
the Economic Section,will assist the 70 Muirhead Rd offi-
ce so that only those who really need them,will receive
passes.

satisfaction about the work done by the Jewish Gemeinde
and stressed the necessity for everybody to rely on him-
self rather than rely on the efforts of others. He said
that productive work would receive support from the Ja-
panese Authorities. Mr.Kubota's words were translated
by Dr.A.J.Cohn.

opening of the Ward Rd Hospital, he had again reason for
congratulation. He dealt with the usefulness of the
training of youth after school and mentioned that at the

主题：犹太公会“学业延续”课程开学典礼

1943年9月12日上午11时，在汇山路57号百老汇大戏院举行了上述目的的典礼，约有500人出席。典礼包括演讲、合唱及独唱表演。

犹太公会执行官格拉瑟先生（Mr. Glaser）用英语发表演讲拉开典礼序幕，他解释说，现任当局很快意识到了青年教育的重要性，必须竭尽全力推进这一目标。他还提到经济科作为所有生产性工作的基础，以及课程机构与经济科未来的合作，旨在为失业青年寻找工作。值得注意的是，他还提到即将更新的特别通行证事宜，经济科将协助缪尔黑德路70号办公室，确保只有真正需要的人才能获得通行证。

继格拉瑟先生之后，久保田先生（Mr. Kubota）对犹太公会所做的工作表示满意，并强调每个人都必须依靠自己，而不是依赖他人的努力。他说，生产性工作将获得日本当局的支援。久保田先生的讲话由 A.J. 科恩博士（Dr. A.J. Cohn）翻译。

科恩博士本人表示，在华德路医院开业一周后，他再次有了值得祝贺的理由。他谈到了放学后青年培训的作用，并提到目前他已有400-500个来自日本

SUBJECT: Re: Jewish Gemeinde

It is learnt that on June 26th, 1943 the Jewish Gemeinde received orders from the 70 Muirhead Rd office to form an Economical Section for the control of the entire refugee trade. It is intended to form two sub-sections (a) Trade and (b) Crafts. Every refugee engaged in activities belonging to the two Sections will have to be registered with the Economic Section of the Jewish Gemeinde. Announcements to this effect will be published shortly in the Shanghai Jewish Chronicle. It is furthermore intended to establish a branch of the Jewish Chamber of Commerce inside the Designated Area.

Regarding the two existing arbitration courts it is learnt that negotiations for an unification will be soon concluded so that infuture there will be only one court. Another new activity of the Jewish Gemeinde is the socalles "Krankenhilfe" (Sick-Fund) which will be included into the Welfare Dept. of the Gemeinde. The idea of the Sick Fund is similar to an insurance where regular fees are paid and in case of sickness, the Sick-Fund will pay expenses of treatment and medicine in accordance with the conditions of the Fund.

SUBJECT: Lecture by Rabbi Seber on "Judaism of To-Day"

1. Organizer: Jewish Gemeinde, represented by Mr. R.R.
Glaser, 103 Kiukiang Rd, Tel. 18047

2. Lecturer: Rabbi K.H. Seber, Rabbi of the Jewish Gemei
inde, residing at 685/7 E. Seward Rd

3. Time and date of lecture; 8.45 p.m. to 9.30 p.m.
April 6th, 1943

4. Place: 207 Macgregor Rd

5. Number of persons attending: 12

6. Object: To keep Jews interested in religious matters

7. Contents of lecture:

The title "Judaism of To-Day" was chosen
by the lecturer in order to show what Judaism can
mean to the present day Jew. Rabbi Seber said that
the Jewish religion demands life in accordance with
3 main principles namely Justice, Truth, and Love.
Even if many Jews have ceased keeping religious
rites, which means attending synagogues, obeying the
religious prescriptions regarding food, keeping
of rest on Sabbath etc., they should continue to
live in accordance with the basic principles of
Judaism. He stated that if these principles were
followed there would be better care taken of the
poor and of the education of Youth. Even for a not
religious person the Judaism can guide a person's
life. The ethical principles of the Bible have been
accepted by the whole monotheistic world. This is
something the Jews should consider and therefore
set examples to all others. He regretted that the
interest in Jewish circles for spiritual matters
was very small and that particularly the younger
generation did not attend lectures if this kind.
He continued that the question to day is not whether
Judaism will survive but whether Jewry will survive
The Jews are the only people who were not lead by
politicians through the last 2000 years and who ne-
ver during this period used force to maintain their
existence. By keeping up the true spirit of Judaism
and by living in accordance with it, the Jews can
can contribute to the welfare of all human beings.

（印：FILE）

8. Comment:
Efforts are made by several Jewish institutions
to raise the interest in spiritual matters among
Jews, particularly the refugees in Shanghai. These
efforts have in the past had little result because
it can be noticed that lectures like the above are
always attended by the same kind of persons and so
do not reach those for whom they are meant. As it is
people are so deep in their every-day cares that they
find little time and concentration for such things.

主题：塞伯拉比（Rabbi Seber）关于“当今的犹太教”的演讲

1. 组织者：犹太公会（Jewish Gemeinde），由 R.R. 格拉瑟先生代表，地址：九江路103号，电话：18047

2. 演讲者：K.H. 塞伯拉比（Rabbi K.H. Seber），犹太公会拉比，住址：西华德路东段685/7号

3. 演讲时间及日期：1943年4月6日，晚上8:45至9:30

4. 地点：麦格雷戈路207号

5. 出席人数：12人

6. 目的：保持犹太人对宗教事务的兴趣

7. 演讲内容：

演讲者选择“当今的犹太教”这一标题，旨在展示犹太教对现代犹太人意味着什么。塞伯拉比表示，犹太教要求生活遵循三大主要原则，即正义、真理和爱。即使许多犹太人不再遵守宗教仪式，这意味着不再去会堂、不遵守关于食物的宗教规定、不在安息日休息等，他们仍应继续按照犹太教的基本原则生活。他指出，如果遵循这些原则，穷人和青年教育将得到更好的照顾。即使对于非宗教人士，犹太教也能指引其人生。《圣经》的伦理原则已被整个一神论世界所接受。这是犹太人应当考虑的事情，因此应为其他人树立榜样。他遗憾地表示，犹太圈子对精神事务的兴趣非常小，特别是年轻一代不参加此类讲座。他接着说，今天的问题不是犹太教能否幸存，而是犹太民族能否幸存。犹太人是过去2000年中唯一未由政治家领导，且在此期间从未使用武力来维持其生存的民族。通过保持犹太教的真正精神并按照其生活，犹太人可以为全人类的福祉做出贡献。

（印：归档）

8. 评论：
几家犹太机构正努力提升犹太人，特别是上海难民，对精神事务的兴趣。这些努力在过去收效甚微，因为可以注意到，像上述这样的讲座总是由同一类人参加，因此未能触及那些原本 intended 的目标人群。由于人们深陷于日常琐事之中，很少有时间及精力专注于此类事物。

that will be delivered by Rabbi S o b e r
on Thursday, April 22nd, 1943 at 8.30 p.m.

The speech will appeal to educated non-orthodox Jews
who hold that the rites and ceremonies of the Passover
Festival refer to a legend of remote ages and therefore
have no claim to bind modern people.

an example in order to elucidate the difference between
mythos and religion, and to make out why and in which
way modern Jews can stick to a religious life.

SUBJECT: Membership of The Jewish Gemeinde

In April 1942 membership of the Jewish
Gemeinde was declared compulsory for all stateless
Central European Jewish refugees in a notification
by the Jewish Gemeinde, published in the "Shanghai
Jewish Chronicle". In spite of the notification
only 2/3rd of the above mentioned persons did register
with the Gemeinde. Actually the Gemeinde has no means
to force persons to register. They can only be denied
the use of the Gemeinde's institutions. The Russian
Emigrants' Committee, contrary to the Jewish Gemeinde,
is in a much better position because it issues pass-
ports. If the Gemeinde had any such function it would
be much easier to make people register.

The present number of members of the Gemein-
de is slightly over 6000. As in some cases only the head
of family is registered it can be said that the Gemein-
de represents about 10.000 persons. According to esti-
mates there are another 5.000 persons who by their
status would belong to the Gemeinde but did not register
The reason for their failure to register lies either
in their dislike to pay fees, or dissatisfaction with
the way in which the Gemeinde conducts its business,
or personal grudges against leading members of the
Gemeinde, etc. This certainly shows a lack of co-opera-
tive spirit because the problems and tasks which face
the Gemeinde can only be solved if all refugees co-ope-
rate. This must be said with particular reference to
the financial question. As it is, at present, member-
ship with the Gemeinde is voluntary and that is why
many refugees choose not to belong to it.

1942年4月，犹太公会在《上海犹太纪事报》上发布通知，宣布所有无国籍的中欧犹太难民必须加入犹太公会。尽管有此通知，但上述人员中只有三分之二在公会进行了登记。实际上，公会没有任何手段强制人们登记。他们只能拒绝这些人使用公会的机构。与犹太公会相反，俄国移民委员会的地位要好得多，因为它签发护照。如果公会拥有此类职能，让人们登记就会容易得多。

目前公会会员人数略超过6000人。由于在某些情况下仅户主一人登记，可以说公会代表了约10,000人。据估计，另有5,000人按其身份本应属于公会成员，但未进行登记。他们未登记的原因，要么是不愿缴纳会费，要么是对公会的经营方式不满，或是对公会领导成员怀有个人恩怨等。这确实显示出缺乏合作精神，因为公会面临的问题和任务只有在所有难民合作的情况下才能解决。这一点在财务问题上尤为明显。目前，加入公会纯属自愿，这就是许多难民选择不加入的原因。

SUBJECT: Cemetary of the Communal Association of Central European Jews (Jewish Gemeinde).

The grounds where at present European Jewish Refugees are buried are located at 8001 Point Rd. These grounds are administrated by the Jewish Gemeinde.
Burials at the above locality commenced in September 1941 Since then a total of 400 dead have been buried there.
The capacity of the cemetary allowing only about 20 more graves, the Jewish Gemeinde is faced with the necessity of finding new burial grounds. In order to raise funds for this purpose advertisements have repeatedly been inserted in the "Shanghai Jewish Chronicle" to the effect that $ 100.000.- will be needed for the aquisition of new grounds. So far only $ 400.- have been donated.

Regarding the finding of new grounds, nothing is being done yet because the financial side will have to be settled first.

The still available 20 graves will last for one more month only and the matter is regarded by the Jewish Gemeinde as very pressing. They have got into contact with the other two Jewish communities in Shanghai, The Ashkenazi Jewish Communal Association and the Sephardic Community, regarding the above matter and the 3 communities will shortly publish another appeal for funds.

Dear Sirs:-

I beg to apply for the permission of a cultural
performance of our Association on January 7, 1943 for which
we give the following details:

Manager: Communal Association of Central European Jews
Place: 207 [此处转录不清] Rd., in the premises of the
Association's Synagogue
Date: January 7, 1943 8.15 p.m.
Speaker: Rabbi Sober
Topic: "Zionism in its relation to the biblic idea
of a Jewish State"
("Zionismus und Jüdische Staatsidee").

Contents:
The speech will be based on the 10th Chapter
of the prophet Jesaja designing his thoughts about an ideal
Jewish state in accordance with the teachings of Jewish
religion. A review of the basic points of modern Zionism as
put down by Theodor Herzl on the various zionistic congresses
in the end of the 19th century (1897-1904) will make out the
continuity of Jewish Thought throughout the centuries. If we
feel that the ancient ideals of our people are still active
in a modern way, we shall acknowledge our duty to keep alive
the continuity of Jewish Thought in order to grant the future
existence of our people.

[印：COMMUNAL ASSOCIATION OF CENTRAL EUROPEAN JEWS GEMEINDE]

Dear Sirs,
Your most obedient servants
Communal Association of Central European Jews
( Juedische Gemeinde )
